# issued at

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:issuedAt`](gmeow-issuedAt.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/issuedAt>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The instant an attestation was issued. Functional: the issue time is constitutive of the attestation's identity.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) -> [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:issuedAt`](gmeow-issuedAt.md) from [`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) to [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to stamp the single instant a vouching act was issued — the wall-clock moment the attester signed and released the envelope.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the validity window (use [`gmeow:validFrom`](gmeow-validFrom.md) / [`gmeow:validUntil`](gmeow-validUntil.md)) or the verification time (that lives on the [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md)); and because it is functional, a different issue time is a different attestation.

### How to use

- Set one [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) issue instant; bound usability separately with gmeow:validFrom/validUntil (revocation sets [`validUntil`](gmeow-validUntil.md)), and let transparency-log inclusion time ride on the [`gmeow:TransparencyLogEntry`](../classes/gmeow-TransparencyLogEntry.md) rather than here.

### Examples

- ex:provAtt [`gmeow:issuedAt`](gmeow-issuedAt.md) "2026-06-15T10:00:00Z"^^[xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)
